home.title: NHimmo: offline rental management app for Android
home.description: Manage apartments, tenants, water and electricity readings, invoices, payments and deposits from your phone, without internet. Signed PDF invoices, French and English.
home.og_title: NHimmo: rental management in your pocket
home.og_description: Readings, invoices, receipts, deposits and dashboards: everything to manage your rentals on Android, even offline.
home.hero_text: Apartments, tenants, water and electricity readings, invoices, payments, deposits: NHimmo brings all your rental management to your phone. Your data stays with you.
home.features_title: Everything you need to manage your rentals
home.features_text: Built for landlords and property managers who read the meters themselves every month.

features.title: Properties and tenants
features.text: Owners, buildings, apartments, tenants and leases, with the full history of every unit.

features.title: Readings with photos
features.text: Enter water and electricity readings, photograph the meter, and let the app flag unusual consumption.

features.title: Automatic billing
features.text: Rent, consumption, meter maintenance, VAT and services (parking…) calculated for every tenant in one tap.

features.title: Configurable charges
features.text: One calculation for water, electricity or gas: unit price, maintenance, VAT included or added. Add a new utility in seconds.

features.title: Payments and credit
features.text: Partial payments, advances automatically deducted from the next invoices, balances and overdue amounts always up to date.

features.title: Signed documents
features.text: Invoices, receipts and move-out statements as PDFs, with a signed QR code the app verifies to detect forgeries.

features.title: Deposits and move-out
features.text: Track incomplete deposits, room-by-room inspections, damages deducted from the deposit and the final balance.

features.title: Tenant benefits
features.text: Exemptions, discounts or free units (utility employees, owner's agreement…), which you can enable or suspend at any time.

features.title: Dashboards
features.text: Occupancy, collections, outstanding amounts, consumption: a global view plus a detailed record per property and tenant.

features.title: Exports and backups
features.text: Excel or CSV exports of readings, billing or all data, and full backups you can restore.

features.title: Bilingual
features.text: French or English interface, and documents produced in each tenant's language.

features.title: Leases and renewals
features.text: Prorated move-in and move-out, automatic renewal, tracked due dates: no lease ends without your decision.

home.spot1_text: Every month, NHimmo lists the meters to read, shows the previous reading and computes consumption as you type.
spot1_points: Alert when a reading drops or consumption doubles
home.spot2_text: One tap generates invoices for every tenant. Each document is a professional PDF signed with a QR code.
spot2_points: Rent, charges, services and VAT itemised
Share via WhatsApp, email or print
home.spot3_title: Balances, deposits and move-outs under control
home.spot3_text: Every tenant has a record: balance, overdue amounts, deposit paid or incomplete, services, benefits and payment history.
spot3_points: Move-out statement with damages and deposit
Only the latest payment remains editable
home.steps_title: Up and running in three steps

steps.title: Install NHimmo
steps.text: Download the app from this site: the right version for your phone is picked automatically.

steps.title: Add your properties
steps.text: Create your buildings, apartments, meters and tenants, or try the demo data first.

steps.title: Read and bill
steps.text: Every month, enter the readings, generate the invoices and record the payments. Everything else is calculated for you.

home.gallery_title: Take a look at the app
home.privacy_text: NHimmo works without an account or server: all your information is stored on your phone. Backups and exports keep you in control.

faq.a: Yes. Every feature (readings, invoices, payments, PDFs, exports) works offline. Internet is only needed to share a document or send a backup.
Only on your phone. No management data is sent to a server. Remember to create regular backups and keep them somewhere else (Drive, email, USB stick).

faq.q: Which devices can I install it on?
faq.a: Android phones and tablets running Android 7.0 or later. The app is not available on iPhone yet.

faq.q: How do I install the downloaded file?
faq.a: Open the downloaded file and allow installation from your browser if Android asks. Detailed steps are on the download page.

faq.q: Can I manage water, electricity and gas?
faq.a: Yes. Each meter type has its own unit price, maintenance fee and VAT. You can add a new type at any time.

faq.q: Can English-speaking tenants get documents in English?
faq.a: Yes. Each tenant has a document language: their invoices, receipts and statements are produced in French or English.

privacy.title: NHimmo privacy policy
privacy.description: How NHimmo and this website handle your data: local storage in the app, contact form and downloads.
privacy.og_description: Your management data stays on your phone. Learn how we handle messages sent from this website.

p: NHimmo works without an account or server. The information you enter (properties, tenants, readings, photos, invoices, payments) is stored only on your phone.
We have no access to it. It only leaves your device if you choose to share a document, an export or a backup.
Backup and export files are created on your phone. You decide where to send them (Drive, email, messaging…). Keep them safe: they contain your management data.
When you write to us, your name, email, optional phone number and message are stored so that we can reply, then forwarded by email to the NHimmo team.
This information is never sold or shared. You can ask us to delete it at any time by writing to us.
This website and the installation files are hosted by Google Firebase. Like any host, it may log technical connection data (IP address, browser) for security purposes.
This website uses no advertising cookies and no audience measurement tool.
For any question about your data, write to the address shown on the contact page.
